title: Theme share cards: every /themes page shares its own Stage card with the theme's name

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03 17:23Z took every recommended option from the theme readiness audit; share cards come from one Stage-gradient generator with the theme name

detail: Every theme page shared the root Frequency card, so a link to /themes/bold looked the same as a link to the home page. The one Stage share card (lib/og/stage-card.tsx) now draws a card per theme: kicker 'A Frequency Theme', the theme's name, its tagline, a cover from the theme's own photo set. Static files under public/brand/theme-share/<id>.jpg (outside public/themes, whose folders lib/themes/library.test.ts reserves for owner-made assets), drawn by scripts/render/theme-share-cards.render.tsx, because a new opengraph-image route fans out into the build (check:og-trace) and the production build already runs near its memory ceiling. FrequencyPageSeo gained an optional shareImage that frequencyPageMetadata reads; New World, Bold, Wildheart, Network, Temple, Nocturne and Designer set it. Bold's cover is a general Frequency photo until Bold's own photo set lands (ASSETS-FOR-DANIEL item 6). CLOSED 2026-11-03.
